title: Google Adwords for salons & clinics | Salon Guru

facts.fact: Salon Guru says it has created and managed hair salon advertising campaigns across the UK, Ireland and the USA.
facts.quote: we've created and managed successful hair salon advertising campaigns across the UK, Ireland and the USA.

facts.fact: Salon Guru's Google Ads pricing has a one-time set-up cost per campaign, which covers steps 1-4 of its campaign process; the page does not publish the amount.
facts.quote: For each campaign there is a set up cost that covers steps 1-4 above above.

facts.fact: Salon Guru's Google Ads packages include monthly management and analysis costs for 3 months.
facts.quote: Then there are monthly management and analysis costs for 3 months.

facts.fact: Salon Guru does not publish a fixed Google Ads price; it gives a bespoke quotation on request.
facts.quote: to discuss a bespoke quotation and price for your Google Ads campaign.

facts.fact: Salon Guru says an SEO-optimised salon website usually takes a few weeks to reach the top of organic search results for multiple key phrases.
facts.quote: It usually takes a few weeks to organically get you to the top of internet searches for multiple key phrases.

facts.fact: Salon Guru's Google Ads campaign process has five initial steps: identify target phrases, optimise the landing page, create the keyword list, create ads, and manage the campaign.
